sources.entry: RapidForge - Lightweight platform for building webhooks, scheduled tasks and pages. Implement your logic with Bash or Lua. (Source Code) Apache-2.0 Go/Nodejs

summary.one_liner: RapidForge is a lightweight, self-hosted platform for building webhooks, APIs, scheduled tasks and dynamic pages using Bash or Lua scripts.
summary.what_it_does: RapidForge provides a web interface for creating HTTP webhook endpoints with custom paths and methods, running scripts on a cron-like schedule, and building interactive pages with a drag-and-drop editor and embedded scripts. Scripts can be written in Bash or Lua, and the Lua runtime includes built-in HTTP and JSON libraries. It stores data in SQLite and includes built-in authentication via OAuth2 integration and bearer tokens. It logs webhook executions and responses and includes a self-updater. The README describes the backend as Go with the Gin framework and the frontend as HTMX with Shoelace components.
use_cases: build small internal APIs with shell scripts
automate tasks with Bash or Lua
notable: Single self-contained binary with no external dependencies
Bundled portable Lua binary from the superconfigure project, which prefers a system-installed lua when present
Visual drag-and-drop page builder with embedded scripts
Admin user and password generated and printed to stdout on first start
Versions managed centrally via mise and a make sync-versions target
caveats: Configuration details are only in external documentation at rapidforge.io/docs
Building from source requires mise to install Go and Node.js toolchains
Initial admin password is printed only once at first start
keywords: receive webhooks and run a script
build an api without a framework
